title: At Pune's Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research

sections.heading: Heritage Club
sections.content:
Coordinator of Club : Prof. Rama Gaikwad (Head, Computer Engineering),
Email: rama.gaikwad@abmspcoerpune.org
The Heritage Club at Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering and Research is dedicated to fostering awareness and appreciation of our rich cultural heritage among students. This initiative aims to preserve and promote our ancient traditions, social reformers, and the values they represent. Through a variety of engaging activities such as crafts, museum visits, heritage walks, and guest lectures, the club encourages students to explore the significant contributions of social reformers and historical figures. Our objectives include instilling pride in the local and national heritage, promoting the habit of reading biographies, and cultivating an understanding and appreciation of India’s diverse cultural legacy. Join us in celebrating and safeguarding our heritage for future generations!
